related.title: JUPITER 模組超算系統
related.why: 可遷移節點、互連、I/O及復原的分層分析；拓撲、資源配置與工作流不同。
related.whyEn: Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
related.transfer: 可遷移節點、互連、I/O及復原的分層分析；拓撲、資源配置與工作流不同。
related.transferEn: Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
related.difference: 本課針對GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工；JUPITER 模組超算系統改以Booster、Cluster 與多層儲存協作為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on gpu booster and general-node workflow division; JUPITER modular supercomputing system centers on booster, cluster and tiered-storage cooperation, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Booster GPU與主機與GH200與CPU模塊，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到JUPITER 模組超算系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以跨分區排程為起點，設計一項能區分「GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工」與「Booster、Cluster 與多層儲存協作」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare booster gpu and host with gh200 and cpu modules and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to JUPITER modular supercomputing system, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from cross-partition scheduling and propose an observation distinguishing gpu booster and general-node workflow division from booster, cluster and tiered-storage cooperation, including uncertainty.

history.title: Leonardo Booster 與資料分區
history.text: Leonardo Booster 與資料分區的公開資料展示GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Leonardo Booster and data-centric partitions illustrate gpu booster and general-node workflow division. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型

history.text: 本課將GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns gpu booster and general-node workflow division into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
